{{Quote|You're just in time, Senator Amidala.|Orf Madroo, to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], during the conference on Gus Talon|<ref name="Power Down" />}}
[[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] '''Orf Madroo''' was a [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Madroo attended a peace [[Conference on Gus Talon|conference]] that was held on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] to discuss what actions to take in response to recent [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity in the region.
